## Target of the Florida probe (February 2026)

In February 2026 the [[department-of-justice|Justice Department]] issued additional subpoenas in the [[florida-criminal-probe-of-2016-russia-assessment|Florida criminal probe of the 2016 Russia assessment]], a criminal investigation examining the U.S. intelligence community's response to Russian election interference in 2016.[{n}] Brennan, who played a central role in producing the January 2017 [[intelligence-community-assessment|intelligence community assessment]] concluding that [[russia|Russia]] interfered to help [[donald-trump|Donald Trump]] defeat [[hillary-clinton|Hillary Clinton]], has been told he is a target of the investigation.[{n}] His attorneys, in a December letter to the chief judge of the Southern District of Florida, labeled the probe "manufactured" and said it remains unclear what potential crimes prosecutors are investigating.[{n}] The Justice Department declined to comment, and it is not yet known whether the inquiry will produce charges.[{n}]

Whereas the first round of subpoenas in November covered the months surrounding the assessment's preparation and publication, the latest demands seek any records from the years since, a widening that Badlands contributor Ashe in America read as evidence that prosecutors are examining ongoing acts in furtherance of the alleged conspiracy rather than only conduct from Trump's first term.[{n}] She noted that Brennan has held positions of influence or authority continuously since 9/11 and argued that, if intent can be proven before the grand juries now weighing the evidence, the conduct would constitute sedition or, if foreign-incentivized, treason.[{n}]

## Fiscal year 2027 preliminary budget

On February 17, 2026, Mamdani released a preliminary $127 billion budget for fiscal year 2027 that included a proposed 9.5 percent hike in property tax rates, the first such increase in more than two decades.[{n}] He described the move as a reluctant "last resort" to address a $5.4 billion deficit inherited from the previous administration, which he blamed on years of fiscal mismanagement.[{n}]

Mamdani laid out two paths for closing the gap: pressing Governor [[kathy-hochul|Kathy Hochul]] and state lawmakers in Albany to raise taxes on high earners and profitable corporations, or relying on the limited tools available to the city, which would mean a broad-based property tax increase on millions of homes and commercial properties together with withdrawals from reserve funds.[{n}] The hike would generate roughly $3.7 billion.[{n}] City Comptroller [[mark-levine|Mark Levine]] called the property tax option "a pretty extreme option."[{n}]

## 2026 cancellation push

In February 2026 Israeli Finance Minister [[bezalel-smotrich|Bezalel Smotrich]] announced that the next Israeli government must cancel the Oslo Accords outright, extend Israeli sovereignty across the [[west-bank-annexation|West Bank]], and encourage Palestinian emigration from the West Bank and Gaza Strip, describing these steps as essential to foreclose any Palestinian state.[{n}]

Badlands commentary recapitulated the accords' terms as signed in 1993: Palestine would immediately recognize the State of [[israel|Israel]], and in exchange the [[israel-defense-forces|IDF]] would implement a five-year plan to incrementally withdraw from Gaza and the West Bank and ultimately recognize Palestine as a nation.[{n}] The signing prime minister, [[yitzhak-rabin|Yitzhak Rabin]], a retired IDF general, was assassinated by a Jewish terrorist, an event that opened the way for the rise of [[benjamin-netanyahu|Bibi Netanyahu]].[{n}] Netanyahu has bragged that on taking power in 1996 he intentionally subverted the accords and ensured the troop drawdown never happened, meaning the framework was hollowed out in practice decades before Smotrich called for its formal repeal.[{n}]

## Maritime Security Belt 2026

As the second round of indirect U.S.–[[iran|Iran]] nuclear talks wrapped up in Geneva in February 2026, [[iran|Iran]], [[russia|Russia]] and [[china|China]] launched joint naval exercises known as Maritime Security Belt 2026 in the [[strait-of-hormuz|Strait of Hormuz]].[{n}] The drills followed shortly after separate Iranian Revolutionary Guard exercises that included anti-ship missile tests and temporary closures of sections of the vital oil chokepoint.[{n}] The timing underscored that tensions remained high despite reported diplomatic movement, coming alongside a warning from Supreme Leader [[ali-khamenei|Ali Khamenei]] that Iran possesses weapons capable of sending American warships to the bottom of the sea.[{n}]
